outcome: failure of second-trimester pregnancy termination (defined as no abortion within 48 hours)
cohort: Participants were women with singleton pregnancies between 14 and 28 weeks of gestation, with an unfavorable cervix, no spontaneous labor pain, intact membranes, undergoing second-trimester termination with misoprostol as a single agent.
finding: Early gestational age, live fetuses, sublingual misoprostol regimen of 400 mcg every 6 h, and high maternal pre-pregnancy BMI were significant risk factors for the failure of second-trimester termination with misoprostol.
